climate: Pinot Noir and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A large Southern Oregon AVA covering the Rogue River valley and its tributary valleys, such as the Applegate. It is the warmest and driest of Oregon's wine regions, and Pinot Noir is its most planted grape, followed by Pinot Gris.
